findings.text: The company was incorporated on 3 August 2012 and has been active for 14.2 years.
There is no insolvency record held for the company at Companies House.
Accounts are not overdue, with the last accounts made up to 31 December 2025 and the next due on 30 September 2027.
The confirmation statement is not overdue, with the last statement made up to 24 February 2026 and the next due on 10 March 2027.
There are two current directors, PERSON 697 and PERSON 698, both appointed on 2 October 2025.
One person with significant control is registered: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 2978, which holds 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
One charge is registered in total, which is satisfied, with no outstanding or part-satisfied charges.
Since 24 October 2025, there have been no registered office address changes, but one officer, PERSON 699, resigned as secretary on 1 December 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 779 is an active company incorporated in 2012 with no insolvency records and up-to-date statutory filings.
